# Troubleshooting

Use a development build to read the full error message and identify the component involved. Verify that solid-js and @solidjs/web both use the supported Solid 2.0.0-rc.13 version.

This Solid port does not use the upstream React production error-code catalog. Include the complete error, package versions, and a minimal reproduction when reporting a problem.

[Report an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/unstyled-solid/base-ui)
